Name: JIGGLER_BEHAVIOR_PARAM_ST
Description: Determines the rotational behavior of a jiggle bone.

Fields.Name: Minimum Acceleration for Rotation
Fields.Description: The minimum acceleration at which the bone starts to rotate. In metres per second squared.

Fields.Name: Acceleration for Maximum Rotation
Fields.Description: The acceleration at which the rotational force reaches its maximum value. In metres per second squared.

Fields.Name: Minimum Velocity for Rotation
Fields.Description: The minimum velocity to start the rotation of the bone. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Velocity for Maximum Rotation
Fields.Description: The velocity at which the rotational force reaches its maximum value. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Rotational Acceleration: X-Axis
Fields.Description: Coefficient that turns velocity and acceleration into rotation about the X axis.

Fields.Name: Rotational Acceleration: Y-Axis
Fields.Description: Coefficient that turns velocity and acceleration into rotation about the Y axis.

Fields.Name: Rotational Decay: X-Axis
Fields.Description: The coefficient that dampens the angular velocity on the X-axis.

Fields.Name: Rotational Decay: Y-Axis
Fields.Description: The coefficient that dampens the angular velocity on the Y-axis.

Fields.Name: Bounce Rate at Minimum Angle: X-Axis
Fields.Description: Bounce rate when the X-axis rotation reaches its minimum limit angle.

Fields.Name: Bounce Rate at Maximum Angle: X-Axis
Fields.Description: Bounce rate when the X-axis rotation reaches its maximum limit angle.

Fields.Name: Bounce Rate at Minimum Angle: Y-Axis
Fields.Description: Bounce rate when the Y-axis rotation reaches its minimum limit angle.

Fields.Name: Bounce Rate at Maximum Angle: Y-Axis
Fields.Description: Bounce rate when the Y-axis rotation reaches its maximum limit angle.
